operation_details.item: The user prefers first-person personal storytelling with emotional framing in internal strategy memos instead of data tables and KPI bullets.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning — how’s the strategy work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’m shaping an internal strategy memo for next week’s leadership discussion.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you leaning toward a crisp executive summary with the key metrics up front?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Not this time. I want it to feel more human and memorable than the usual dashboard-style update.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That could work well. What kind of structure are you considering?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I prefer first-person storytelling, with some emotional framing around what the team experienced and why the decision matters. I’ll use the data to support the story rather than lead with tables and KPI bullets.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For internal strategy memos, I want first-person personal storytelling with emotional framing instead of data tables, KPI bullets, or neutral analysis.
